execution.queueRule: Teams author concurrently. Ready immutable jobs are sent to integration team; only an explicitly leased job may run any Cargo/rustfmt/Node/app/test/container phase. Global nonblocking build lock stays enabled. No polling.
execution.leaseScope: Complete existing Site slice Event PATCH operator/predicate casts and fixed future scheduling;8ownedpaths;isolated source/Mongo/HTTP/runtime checks;explicit jobs1;no other teams WIP
execution.pythonInvocation: python3 -B (preserve immutable jobs by suppressing import .pyc files)

communication: Event driven: send root/integration one ready/blocked/completed message with file list, source tree and proof paths; no periodic pings, task_status polling, sleeps or watchers. Root sends execution lease and dependency handoffs only.
claims: Before editing declare exact paths in a per-team claims JSON. Baseline TS file ownership governs paired Rust files. New shared/ambiguous helpers require a contract event and explicit single owner; do not collide. Temporary reservations override permanent owners until root releases them.
completion: Authoring is not acceptance. Required native application adapters + isolated behavior checks + integration review precede local completion. Total migration remains open.
readyWorkPreexisting: File routes and announcements/plain-chat scopes are authored and unverified; both reserved for Sol integration partner. Legacy Polar active, sole execution owner until phase handoff.
